summary: Uttarakhand first-party sources document a state BhuNaksha cadastral-map portal and identify the Board of Revenue as land-record custodian; the public viewer timed out before its current JavaScript/configuration, hierarchy, schema, or parcel service could be inspected. No parcel ID or polygon is retained and runtime remains held.

GET requests to https://bhunaksha.uk.gov.in/ and https://bhunaksha.uk.gov.in/05/index.html each timed out after 20 seconds. No anonymous ID+geometry request was attempted because the viewer bundle/configuration was unavailable.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [30.096522613497, 78.2806609890294] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted or used to force a parcel hit.
The state portal URL and administrative jurisdiction were evidenced, but Rishikesh revenue-village hierarchy and map coverage were not resolved.
A timeout, login wall, map extent miss, zero exact-point hit, or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.

No owner, address, titleholder, contact, personal, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
